wiki.summary: “Dust” shows Drake reflecting on his longevity in the rap industry, his success, and more. On the first part of the track, Drake reflects on his career, discussing long-distance relationships, fame, and his international lifestyle while traveling across the globe. The track switches to an aggressive tone as Drake flexes his dominance in the rap scene and takes shots at other artists. On May 15, 2026, The track was released as the second song on his ninth full-length studio album ICEMAN. Read more on Last.fm.
